main_text.head: CAPVT XVI.
De exemplis Aureæ Regulæ, partium aut mistorum numerationem ante se requirentibus.
main_text.p: IN dictis exemplis integrorum quædam numeratio ante proportionis conclusionem requisita fuit: in sequentibus erit partium & mistorum numeratio.
1. Quidam equo diuendito aureis 75, inuenit se quartam partem sortis lucratum esse: quæritur, quæ nam sors fuerit.

Hic adde sorti, quod ponitur fuisse 4/4, lucrum scilicet 1/4 totus erit 5/4. Cui enim quarta pars sortis ex lucro accedit, is ex 4 acquirit 5. Quare partibus cognominibus ad integra redactis proportio princeps sic erit.

page.notes: The initial I is a woodcut letter, joined to "N" as "IN". Handwritten pencil or ink calculations in the upper right margin and fragments of the facing page at the left edge are not printed text and are omitted. The line "Si 5 sunt 75" and the fractions are transcribed as best read. The final line is cut off by the page foot; the signature mark "G 4" is at the foot.
